Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a cystic lesion in the fetal thorax with a systemic feeding vessel (confirmed by color Doppler), which is characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or hybrid lesion typically located in the lower or middle lung zones; such space-occupying lesions commonly cause mass effect, displacing the heart to the contralateral side and elevating the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm.
